sentences.text: The other claimants of the group of LARs preferred respective First Appeals and one of the First Appeal being No.3144 of 2023 was admitted by the coordinate bench of this Court on 1.8.2023.

After the pronouncement of impugned judgment and award, the advocate of the applicants informed about the passing of the judgment after Uttaryan in the month of January,
2018.
When the applicants contacted their learned advocate, it was informed that he would inform applicants with regard to deposit of compensation by the authority.
Time and again, applicants approached their learned advocates but applicants were informed that the authority has not deposited the amount of compensation.
The back NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/155/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined and forth conversation between the applicants and the learned advocates continued till August 2020.
Even thereafter, the applicants were called upon to provide necessary papers and such communication lasted till March 2021.

In April 2021,
applicants were informed by their learned advocates of reference Court that papers are found and they can be collected from his office.
Applicants collected papers from their learned advocates in the month of May, 2021 and thereafter approached advocates of the High Court in June 2021.
Applicants came to know upon inquiring that the claimants of other land reference cases have also preferred appeals and they are admitted.
It is also contended that applicants are illiterate persons and coming from a very small village.
Application for certified copy of the award was made on 14.2.2022 which was prepared on 24.2.2022.
Applicants received certified copy of the impugned award on 10.3.2022.

Thereafter, the application for condonation of delay together with NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/155/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined memo of first appeal was presented before this Court on 5.2.2024 which was registered on 6.1.2025.
It is submitted that the reasons assigned in the application for condonation of delay is sufficient and there is no intention on the part of applicants to drag the proceedings.

It is therefore prayed that in the interest of justice,
delay may be condoned.
No other submissions are made by learned advocate for the applicants.

4. Per contra, landed AGP for the respondent has objected in condoning delay by stating that the explanation which are stated in the application are not worth considering and they cannot be termed as a sufficient cause.
It is further contended that the impugned judgment and award is passed on 22nd November, 2017.

The awarded compensation has been deposited in July 2019 and thereafter the present applicants have withdrawn the amount of compensation and accepted the award in the same NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/155/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined year.
Even after accepting the award, applicants did not pursue their so called right of enhancement of compensation till 5.2.2024.

It is further contended that the certified copy of the impugned award was received by applicants on 10th March, 2022 and even thereafter for a period of more than one and half year, applicants did not file any appeal and challenge the impugned award.
The conduct of the applicants is such that no leniency can be shown.

It is further submitted that there is a huge days of delay and for condoning such huge delay, applicants should come out with a very strong explanation showing sufficient cause which can impress upon for condoning delay.

It is further contended that this is not a fit case where the discretion can be exercised by adopting a lenient view.
5.
I have considered the submissions and also perused the application for condonation of delay.

sentences.text: 2 6. The claimants of LAR Case No.181 of 1993 are before this Court, who have assailed the judgment and award passed on in group of land acquisition reference cases by the Principal Senior Civil Judge Khambhalia.
Undisputedly, applicants have admitted in their application that they were in knowledge about the impugned judgment and award in the month of January 2018.
However, the applicants remained silent by not challenging the impugned judgment and award and approached learned advocates from March 2018 till July 2021.

Applicants , as per the contention raised in the application, also were aware that some of the claimants have preferred first appeals challenging the impugned judgment and award in the month of 2023 and 2024 and the same are admitted.
As per the submission of learned advocate for the applicant, there are as many as 21 first appeals filed by different claimants before this Court.

One of the first appeals as mentioned in the application being first appeal NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/155/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined number 3144 of 2023 was admitted by coordinate bench of this Court on 1.8.2023.

It is pertinent to observe herein that the claimants applied for the certified copy on 14.2.2022, which was ready on 24.2.2022, claimants collected the certified copy on 10.3.2022.
7.
On the perusal of the application, there is no worth name explanation as to why proceedings were not initiated immediately after 10.3.2022 and waited till 5.2.2024.
It is further necessary to observe that the certified copy of the impugned judgment and award was applied even after the prescribed period of limitation to file appeal was over.

The application is silent with regard to the explanation being tendered as to why the certified copy of the judgment and award was applied so late when the applicants were aware about the impugned judgment and award being passed in 2017.

By communicating with the learned advocates, and the time consumed in NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/155/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined deliberations with the learned advocates is not a sufficient cause for condoning delay.
Unreasonable time consumed in discussion and meetings with the learned advocates is not a sufficient cause.

More particularly, it is surprising to note that the communication with the learned advocates started in January 2018 till July 2021,
for almost three years, the applicants did not find it appropriate to challenge the impugned award.
8. This Court is fully conscious about the fact that the proceedings under the Land Acquisition Act are benevolent proceedings.
The agriculturists who have lost their lands in the process of acquisition must be adequately compensated.

In the present case, the submission of learned AGP is that the compensation has been deposited in the year 2019 which has been disbursed in favour of present applicants in the same year could not be contradicted by the learned advocate for the applicants.
Leniency can be shown NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/155/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined to the litigant who has remained vigilant in assailing the order.

9. The explanations which have been given in the application, as discussed hereinabove, are not sufficient and they did not inspire any confidence because what is explained is only the communication ensued between the claimants and their learned advocates and nothing more than that.
10. Learned advocate for the applicants submitted that claimants are ready to waive and forgo interest on enhanced, if any, awarded.
In the application for condonation of delay, no such averment of waiving of interest is made by the applicants.

A leniency cannot be shown to fence-sitter who Koli Mohan Bijal vs State Of Gujarat on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54846444/
3 watches other proceedings to proceed and when other appeals are admitted, come out slumber and file appeal with an application for condonation of delay.

sentences.text: NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/155/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined 11.
"Sufficient Cause" means that the party should not have acted in a negligent manner or there was a want of Bonafide on its part in view of the facts and circumstances of a case.

The facts and circumstances of each case must afford sufficient ground to enable the Court concerned to exercise discretion for the reason that whenever the Court exercises discretion it has to be exercised judiciously.

The applicant/s must satisfy the court that he was prevented by any sufficient cause from prosecuting his case and unless a satisfactory explanation is furnished the Court should not allow the application for condonation of delay.

12. In the present case, considering the averments made in the application and submissions of the respective parties, I am of the view that the applicants are not bonafide litigants and no convincing and palatable explanation is forthcoming for allowing this application of condonation of delay.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/155/2025 JUDGMENT DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined 13.
In the present case considering overall aspects, conduct of applicants cannot be viewed as a bonafide mistake or lapse.
14. In view of above, this application is merit-less.
Hence, the same stands dismissed.
No order as to costs.
